# port a SetUp to maintainer

Move the "set up all my repositories" logic out of shell scripts into the `maintainer` Go CLI (octomation/maintainer), and take inspiration from Clever's multi-repository tools: [reposync](https://github.com/Clever/reposync) (clone/refresh every repository of an org), [gitbot](https://github.com/clever/gitbot) (apply a change across repositories) and [microplane](https://github.com/Clever/microplane) (the same, as a pipeline: clone, plan, push, merge).

The shell side of this today is [git_sync](../../bin/git_sync) — pull every git directory under the current one — and the `clone` helper; the ask is a real command that knows the author's projects ([#124](DOT-123.md)) and keeps them cloned, up to date and correctly wired to `upstream`/`fork-*` remotes.
